neighbors.establishing_passage: Proposes using generative image editing to simulate dataset shifts and diagnose failure modes of biomedical vision models... RadEdit uses multiple masks to constrain changes and ensure consistency in the edited images.

Chest frontal radiographs are frequently used in clinical practice and a portion of VCFs can be detected through this technology; internal testing sensitivity 83.0% and AUC 0.930 at fracture level; AI assistance improved junior clinician sensitivity from 56.1% to 81.6%.
The group that underwent DXA with CXR-OP had higher risk of all-cause mortality (HR 2.59, 95% CI 1.83-3.67), and those classified as CXR-OP without DXA also had higher all-cause mortality (HR 1.67).

For high-risk individuals Grad-CAM highlighted the mediastinum and aortic knob... sternotomy wires indicated previous cardiothoracic surgery; for low-risk individuals Grad-CAM highlighted the extrathoracic soft-tissues. Code and weights confirmed at github.com/michaeltlu/cxr-risk (cxr-risk_v1.pth).

RoentMod: a counterfactual image editing framework that generates anatomically realistic CXRs with user-specified synthetic pathology while maintaining other anatomical features... models exploit off-target pathology as shortcuts.
Predicted age difference was associated with overall mortality (adjusted HR 1.31, p = 0.001)... spine age discriminated prevalent vertebral fractures and osteoporosis better than chronological age.

Synthetic mucus plugs were generated within segmented airways by transferring voxel-intensity statistics from adjacent intrapulmonary vessels... nnU-Net trained using the synthesized mucus plugs... sensitivity of 0.837 and a false positive rate of 1.91 per CT scan, significantly outperforming the manually annotated model. Data availability: weights/code NOT released; further inquiries directed to the corresponding author.

Each radiological finding is encoded by a sparse set of ~10 vision-encoder channels... Turning off the channels tied to one finding causes that finding's score to collapse while unrelated labels stay stable.

The system uses AI-based algorithms to segment the bronchial tree and identify each bronchopulmonary segment... >=3 obstructed segments: Hazard ratio of 1.27 (95% CI 1.10-1.46) for all-cause mortality.

COIN is a counterfactual inpainting approach that flips the predicted classification label from abnormal to normal... the generative model aims to inpaint the abnormal region, thus reversing the classifier's original prediction label.

An image blending tool allows seamless insertion of lesions extracted from source images into target images, with specific application to pulmonary nodules in chest CT exams, validated by board-certified radiologists.

Models created using non-contrast cross-sectional CT images from multiple areas of interest including the umbilical portion of the portal vein, the first right branch of the portal vein, the confluence of the splenic vein and portal vein, and the maximum cross-section of the spleen.

Concept erasure methods intervene on a model's internal representations to remove information about a target concept by projecting out directions in the activation space... comparing model behavior before and after erasure. (Weaker neighbor: passage from search snippet only.)
A deep learning model based on nnU-Net was developed for automated segmentation of all perigastric veins on contrast-enhanced CT images in patients with sinistral portal hypertension.

Merlin pretraining combines a binary cross-entropy loss over 1,692 hierarchical phenotypes derived from ICD codes with an InfoNCE contrastive loss aligning images to radiology report findings; checkpoint public at HuggingFace stanfordmimi/Merlin and GitHub StanfordMIMI/Merlin. NOTE: the card's identifier arXiv:2407.11399 resolves to an unrelated robotics paper (Multi-Goal Motion Memory, cs.RO).

TMF-LCNet integrates non-contrast abdominal CT images, radiomic features extracted from liver and spleen, and clinical text... adverse outcomes include ascites, hepatic encephalopathy and variceal bleeding.

Diagnosis of Clinically Significant Portal Hypertension Using CT- and MRI-based Vascular Model; CT rule-in/rule-out CSPH criteria noting presence of gastroesophageal varices, spontaneous portosystemic shunt or ascites.

The cervical, thoracic spines, first ribs, aortic arch, heart, rib cage, and soft tissue of thorax and flank seemed to be the most crucial activated regions in the age prediction model... degenerative change in spines is obvious in elderly persons. MAE 2.1 years, r=0.97.
Spine age estimated from lateral spine radiographs and DXA VFA using deep learning outperformed chronological age in discriminating morphologic vertebral fracture and osteoporosis.
RoentMod is a counterfactual image editing framework that generates realistic CXRs with user-specified and synthetic pathology while maintaining the original anatomical features.

neighbors.identifier: PMC11320507 (Quant Imaging Med Surg 2024, Yao et al.)
neighbors.establishing_passage: A deep learning model to measure anatomical parameters of the vertebral body and intervertebral disc based on lateral lumbar radiographs... predicting vertebral body heights, intervertebral disc heights, and intervertebral disc angles.
Averaged saliency maps of the CXR-Age model indicated frequent pixel activation in the mediastinum and heart... Grad-CAM revealed frequent activation in the lower neck and upper mediastinum.

Deep learning segmentation software to extract quantitative chest radiograph biomarkers (lung area, emphysema probability, aortic diameter, heart area, and bone density)... an explainable marker of biological aging.

Sybil's decision function can be effectively approximated by an LMPI consisting of a sample-specific background term and a model of main effects and pairwise interactions over pulmonary nodules... absent pathology, risk estimates should rely on background markers like emphysema. Does NOT test vascular features.
Each standard deviation of more severe pruning (lower BV5/TBV) was associated with a 49% greater rate of recurrence and increased all-cause mortality in 159 resected lung adenocarcinoma patients.
Sybil: data splits, expert radiologist annotations, trained models, and code released at github.com/reginabarzilaygroup/Sybil under MIT license (sybil_1..sybil_5 and sybil_ensemble checkpoints).

neighbors.identifier: PMID 30327507 (Alilou et al., quantitative vessel tortuosity)
neighbors.establishing_passage: Defined 35 quantitative vessel tortuosity (QVT) features including tortuosity, curvature, volume, and overall branching number, achieving average AUC ~0.73; QVT outperformed shape and textural radiomic features.
Each SD lower BV5/TBV (more severe pruning) was associated with a 35% greater rate of death.
Links higher degree of pulmonary vascular pruning (lower ratio of volume of vessels < 5 mm2 to total lung vessel volume) to longitudinal change in emphysema and lung function.
